Hi Elena / FinCo team,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciate the detailed questions from your security and legal folks. Quick summary of the items we discussed and immediate next steps so nothing falls through the cracks:

- Evidence & DSQ: You mentioned a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ). Please send it over and we’ll assign an owner to fill it out.
